messages:
incident-bot: 🔴 ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for customer Stormcliff (VPC: eu1-dedicated). Current p99 = 1620ms, SLO 800ms. Paging oncall. Link: https://metrics.redwood/alert/8543210000 :pager:
oncall-amber: Acked. I'm on it. Gathering initial diffs and recent deploys.
oncall-amber: @sre-raj can you pull pool health and tenant top-talkers for the eu1 dedicated pool? suspect noisy tenant or cache churn.
sre-raj: pulling now. running: `rdwctl pools describe eu1-dedicated --json | jq '.pools[] | {id,util,queue_len}'`
sre-raj: top 3 tenants by qps: stormcliff-main (85%), partner-x (7%), internal-svc (3%). stormcliff-main KV cache hitrate dropped from 94%->28% at 13:02 UTC.
eng-runtime-lee: KV cache regen spike could be from a prompt prefix change or sudden seq-length bump. Any deploys around 13:00?
oncall-amber: No infra deploys in eu1 since 12:40. Customer reported a config roll earlier today (solutions-maya to confirm).
solutions-maya: Received note from Stormcliff ops: they rolled new prompt templates at 12:58 across a few routes. They're on standby for call.
cust-ops-tom: We're available. We pushed a template change but didn't expect long seqs. Rolling back now if that helps.
prod-ops-jen: Quick mitigations we can try in parallel: 1) throttle top tenant to reduce concurrency 2) enable KV-prefetch for hot prefixes 3) failover traffic to warm-spare pool in eu-west (if compatible). Which do we want first?
oncall-amber: Prioritize tenant throttle + failover. @eng-runtime-lee can you prepare fallback model variant (quantized v2-small) for stormcliff-main to reduce avg token latency?
eng-runtime-lee: Preparing variant; can register and route in ~90s if we pin model and apply routing rule. Will need `route-set` from SRE to move 20% -> fallback as canary.
sre-raj: Applying tenant-level concurrency limit: `rdwctl tenant throttle stormcliff-main --concurrency 30` -> applied. Observability: p99 now 1180ms (partial improvement).
eng-runtime-lee: Fallback variant ready. Creating routing rule: `rdwctl routes create --from tenant=stormcliff-main --to model=small-quant-v2 --weight=20` -> deploying.
solutions-maya: I'm on a call with Stormcliff; letting them know we're throttling and enabling fallback. They're ok with temporary degraded quality.
oncall-amber: After route switch p99 dropped to 760ms. That's under SLO. Still watching for tail flares.
sre-raj: Good. KV hitrate for stormcliff-main slowly climbing back to 67%. Queue length down 72% vs peak.
prod-ops-jen: Action items: 1) keep 20% fallback until we confirm stable for 15m 2) schedule tenant prefix pre-warming for Stormcliff 3) postmortem to include change-control gap on their template roll
solutions-maya: I'll coordinate pre-warm template and a safe rollout checklist with Stormcliff. They want a follow-up runbook entry.
oncall-amber: Thanks team. Handoff to SRE for monitoring and post-incident write-up. @sre-raj you own postmortem and timeline capture; set severity P2.
sre-raj: Will create incident report and timeline. Setting follow-up: investigate why cache regen was so complete (hot-key eviction pattern) and evaluate automatic prewarm heuristics. ETA report in 24h.
incident-bot: Incident status update: mitigated -> p99 within SLO via fallback routing and tenant throttle. Severity: P2. Postmortem assigned to sre-raj. :white_check_mark:
